+Show Configuration
+------------------
+
+To print the loaded application's configuration as JSON, use the
+:func:`config <cli.config_command>` command. Sensitive configuration values
+containing ``SECRET``, ``PASSWORD``, ``TOKEN``, or ``KEY`` in their keys will be
+masked as ``"***"``. ::
+
+    $ flask config
+    {
+      "ENV": "production",
+      "DEBUG": false,
+      "TESTING": false,
+      "SECRET_KEY": "***",
+      ...
+    }
+

+@click.command("config", short_help="Show the config values.")
+@with_appcontext
+def config_command() -> None:
+    """Show the config values. Mask sensitive keys."""
+    import json
+
+    config = dict(current_app.config)
+    sensitive_keys = {"SECRET", "PASSWORD", "TOKEN", "KEY"}
+
+    for key in config:
+        if any(s in key.upper() for s in sensitive_keys):
+            config[key] = "***"
+
+    click.echo(json.dumps(config, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=repr))
+
+
